description: This file implements the RemoteControl plugin class for the WPEFramework, providing JSON-RPC methods and IARM event handling for remote control functionalities such as pairing, IR database management, and system reset.

classes.name: RemoteControl
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing remote control functionalities, JSON-RPC methods, and IARM event handling.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number of the plugin.

methods.name: startPairing
methods.description: Initiates remote pairing process via IARM call.

methods.name: stopPairing
methods.description: Stops remote pairing process via IARM call.

methods.name: getNetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves network status of the remote control unit.

methods.name: getIRDBManufacturers
methods.description: Fetches list of IRDB manufacturers, possibly from cloud.

methods.name: getIRDBModels
methods.description: Fetches list of IRDB models, possibly from cloud.

methods.name: getIRCodesByNames
methods.description: Retrieves IR codes by specified names.

methods.name: getLastKeypressSource
methods.description: Gets the source of the last keypress.
